invariants.rationale: The method expects a Stage parameter, and all subsequent logic assumes it is not null.
At method entry, 'this' has not yet been added to the stage's actors list. This will happen at the beginning of the method.
A valid Stage object in LibGDX always has a root Actor; required for Scene2D traversal.
Height is non-negative for a Stage, which is a container for rendering UI elements.
Width is non-negative for a Stage, reflecting display or buffer size for layout computations.
